title: אבא מרי ריש גלותא

paragraphs: Abba Mari, the exilarch. Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak went to appease the exilarch’s wife after a quarrel, because she refused to immerse; see Niddah 67b and Rav Adda of Sura. Maharshal, responsa§6, has 'Rav Naḥman, his son-in-law, went to appease her.'
